Sam (PM): Quick thread to align on GA cut for Console Observability. Need to finalize retention, export expectations, and what we defer to post-GA.
Isha (Eng): Short answer: dashboards + aggregated errors + per-route cost can be GA. Exports and per-tenant raw traces are heavier.
Lena (CS): Customers keep asking for 90d retention and a billing CSV that breaks down tokens by model/version and route. They asked for scheduled monthly exports.
Marco (Telemetry): 90d raw-span retention is expensive. Proposal: raw spans TTL=7d, 1m aggregates retained 90d. Provide CSVs from aggregates. That meets billing needs without storing raw traces forever.
Priya (SRE): We also need a hard cap on trace ingestion per org to avoid noisy tenants causing OOM spikes. Suggest default cap = 10k spans/min per tenant, configurable on enterprise plans.
Isha (Eng): Agreed. Implementation sketch:
```
observability: {
  spans_ttl_days: 7,
  aggregate_window: 60,
  aggregate_retention_days: 90,
  default_span_cap_per_tenant_per_min: 10000
}
```
Sam (PM): For GA acceptance: dashboards with filter by tenant/model/version, cost panel per-route (tokens + cache hit %), error aggregation (total + top reasons), and scheduled aggregate CSV export (monthly) are required. Raw-span retrieval API is not GA.
Lena (CS): Customers on enterprise will need ad-hoc raw span pulls for investigations. Can we put a gated workflow (support ticket -> temporary raw access for 48h)?
Priya (SRE): Yes, that's safer. We'll implement a temporary export job that runs in a sandboxed tenant role and expires. Add audit logs.
Marco (Telemetry): One more thing: to reduce cardinality for error analytics, we'll hash high-cardinality fields and keep both hashed token and sampled plaintext for top-5 reasons. That keeps usefulness and limits storage.
Isha (Eng): We'll also expose a per-tenant sampling override in the Console under "Observability settings". Default sampling: 0.05% global, 2% for routes marked hot. Enterprise can request higher.
Sam (PM): Can we compress scope to hit a 6-week GA? If we postpone scheduled CSV (monthly) to GA+1 sprint and keep an on-demand aggregate export in GA, we can ship earlier. Thoughts?
Priya (SRE): I can sign off if: default caps are enforced, kill-switch for tracing exists per-region, and PD runbook for trace storm is ready.
Lena (CS): I'll tell customers scheduled CSV is targeted for GA+1 and offer the on-demand aggregate export in GA. That's acceptable.
Marco (Telemetry): Actionables: I'll produce storage cost estimates for both 7d vs 30d spans by EOD.
Isha (Eng): I'll open two PRs: 1) telemetry schema for aggregates + caps, 2) Console UI for sampling toggle + on-demand export button. aiming EOD tomorrow.
Sam (PM): Priya, can you draft PD runbook + region kill-switch doc by tomorrow noon?
Priya (SRE): Yep. Also adding an automated alert: if trace ingestion > 70% of provisioned budget for 3m, trigger mitigation playbook.
ops-bot: Feature flag updated: obs-exports -> staging (enabled).
Isha (Eng): :thumbsup: scheduling a follow-up sprint planning slot to prioritize the PRs. If blockers surface we re-evaluate GA date.
Sam (PM): Thanks team 44D I'll update the roadmap entry and notify stakeholders.
